Health & Life Insurance
Health and Life Insurance have many benefits that can help
    maintain your family’s financial stability
    when faced with unexpected situations. It is important that you understand how insurance can
    be a financial resource during these times and plan in advance to ensure that you and your family have the coverage you need to reduce the costs of healthcare and offer a form of financial security. The consumer education materials on this page will help you understand the aspects of health and life insurance and help guide you through your decision making process.

Long-Term Care
Long-term care encompasses a wide range of medical, personal and social services. People may need this care
        if they suffer from a prolonged illness, disability or cognitive impairment. This care includes services provided
        by home health care agencies, adult day care centers, traditional nursing homes and continuing care retirement
        communities.

Medicare Supplement Insurance: Getting Started
Original Medicare pays for many, but not all, health care
    services and supplies. Medicare Supplement Insurance
    (Medigap) policies, sold by private companies, can help pay
    for some of the costs that Original Medicare doesn’t cover, like
    copayments, coinsurance, and deductibles. This official Medicare guide is an overview of Medicare Supplement Insurance policies.

and

Choosing a Medigap Policy
The Choosing a Medigap Policy is an official guide from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services for individuals who are considering purchasing a Medicare Supplement Insurance (Medigap) policy or looking to understand how their Medigap policy works. The information includes Medigap policy coverages, your rights to buy a Medigap policy and guidance on how to buy a Medigap policy.

Health & Life Insurance Resources
Florida KidCare
Florida KidCare offers quality, affordable health and dental insurance for kids. From birth through the end of age 18, Florida children are eligible for head to toe coverage, even if one or both parents are working. Florida KidCare includes free, subsidized and full-pay options based on family income and household size.
www.FloridaKidCare.org
Phone: 1-888-540-KIDS (5437)   TTY 1-800-955-8771
Florida Department of Health
The Florida Department of Health works to protect, promote and improve the health of all people in Florida through integrated state, county and community efforts. They offer an extensive variety of program and services for Floridians of all ages.

Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS)
The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) is part of the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) and provides health coverage to more than 100 million people through Medicare, Medicaid, the Children's Health Insurance Program, and the Health Insurance Marketplace.
CMS.gov
Phone: 1-800-633-4227 (1-877-486-2048)
Florida SHINE (Serving Health Insurance Needs of Elders)
SHINE (Serving Health Insurance Needs of Elders) is a free program offered by the Florida Department of Elder Affairs and your local Area Agency on Aging. Specially trained volunteers can assist you with your Medicare, Medicaid, and health insurance questions by providing one-on-one counseling and information. SHINE services are free, unbiased, and confidential.
www.FloridaShine.org
Phone: 1-800-96-ELDER (1-800-963-5337)
